title: Accessibility-heavy form
instruction: Build an accessible Acme equipment-loan request form with recoverable validation.

knownFacts.required-fields: Name, email, kit, start date, end date, purpose

answerBank.answer: Employees including keyboard and screen-reader users.
Request a kit and recover from input errors.
Native form controls where appropriate; clear focus; no accessibility certification claim.
Use a single coherent form before inventing a multi-step wizard.

primaryTask.goal: Request a kit using only the keyboard, correct invalid dates and a missing purpose, and reach a confirmation retaining the entered information.
steps: Tab through labeled name, email, kit, dates and purpose fields
Submit invalid end date and empty purpose
Reach a linked error summary with understandable messages
Correct the errors without losing entered data

forbiddenRegressions: No error indicated only by color
No clearing valid fields after error
